recommendation.reason: First review of this package (previous_review null, nothing to grade). Short ETH 2 bars in, open +0.036R, peak 0.075R, price (2231.43) = entry after a 16-bar 1h chop (ADX 17) that ranged 2223.4-2242.7. Structure supports the short without a break: 1h highs are stepping down (2245.04 -> 2242.73, 12 bars ago 2241.91) and the stop 2245.60 sits just above the 2245.04 swing high, so it is a structure stop, not arbitrary; 4h (ADX 27) is still lower-highs (2253.3, 2250.6, 2245.0, 2242.7) with a 4h swing low 2221.5 under the 2223.4 hourly low. Nothing has resolved: price is exactly at entry, so I see no thesis change in either direction. HOLD already expresses the view (SL 1.0R above, TP 2210.17 = +1.5R, about 3 ATR below, past both swing lows). Priced from the leg's own history, net, ml_entry short corpus (hold n=527 +0.1528R sd 1.2895 worst -1.2395; one-factor arms): close -0.0434R (ev cost +0.196R vs hold, so exiting a flat trade now just pays away the edge; this is not the close-on-adverse default and I do not take it); tighten arms atr:1.0 +0.1269, atr:1.5 +0.1568, atr:2.0 +0.1529, r:0 +0.1471, r:0.02 +0.1499, all within about 0.6 se of hold (ev_cost se 0.038-0.050) and every one has a WORSE worst case in the replay (-1.998 vs -1.2395), so no tighten is supported, and the class evidence (981 stop-tightens -0.097R) points the same way but does not decide it. Tightening to r:0/atr:1.0 would also put the stop inside the 1.14 ATR bar range of the last hour, i.e. under the 1 ATR minimum buffer. Widen/move_tp: no ATR expansion (htf ATR 16.7 vs 1h 7.1 is normal), TP is behind structure already, so no bracket move beats hold. Book: ETH ml_entry short is the same signal as SOL (reviewed together) and ADA ml_entry, on top of ETH x3 existing shorts, SOL x2, AVAX x2, XRP, BTC, so about a dozen crypto-beta shorts are one concentrated bet; that is flagged, not sized here (account-level risk is each account's own). The -0.13 R/decision 14d figure is the whole-table replay, not this leg's live record, and Unit 23 puts shorts about flat; neither is weighed, hold cell is short-only n=527. Revisit if a 1h bar closes above 2242.7 (lower-high structure broken) or the 4h swing low 2221.5 is lost with momentum toward the TP.
